settings.hover_play_help: When enabled, Lottie and TGS animations in posts will be paused on the first frame and only play when the mouse moves over them.
settings.show_tooltip_help: When enabled, the sticker name appears as a tooltip when you hover over a sticker in posts or in the picker.

sticker_section.import_zip_message: This will import stickers from a ZIP file (exported by this extension). Sticker files will be copied to /assets/stickers/ and existing records will NOT be overwritten. Continue?
sticker_section.import_stickers_message: This will import sticker metadata from a JSON file. Sticker files are NOT included — you need to have them already uploaded. Continue?
sticker_section.import_result: Done: {imported} imported, {skipped} skipped (already existed or invalid).
sticker_section.delete_selected_confirm: Delete {count} sticker(s)? This cannot be undone.
sticker_section.delete_selected_error: The selected stickers could not be deleted. Please try again.

edit_sticker.category_help: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. Special characters are sanitized automatically.
edit_sticker.upload_help: Supports animated Lottie JSON (.json), Telegram stickers (.tgs), PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG.
edit_sticker.delete_sticker_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this sticker?
edit_sticker.save_error: Failed to save sticker. Please check your input and try again.

edit_sticker.external_anim_notice_title: Animated sticker on an external URL
edit_sticker.external_anim_notice_body: Animated stickers (.json / .tgs) must be hosted on this forum's domain to render. Files loaded from an external URL will not animate for visitors — upload the file or use a same-origin path instead.
